senses.gloss:
दृभ् 1. दृभ्, cl. 6. 1. 10. P. दृभति,
दर्भति, दर्भयति, ददर्भ, &c.,
to string together, arrange, tie, fasten.

दृभ् 2. दृभ्, cl. 1. 10. P. दर्भति and
दर्भयति, &c., to fear, be afraid.

दृभीक दृभीक, अस्, m. (fancifully derived
by Sāyaṇa fr. rt. दॄ with 2. भी, ‘fear,’ and 1. कृ),
Ved., N. of a demon slain by Indra.
